scripts.title: FAST KEYLESS SILENT AIM NO BAN
scripts.script:
-- Only here so ScriptBlox's warning banner doesn't overwrite our flags, I'm going to include this method of implementation in my upcoming library so stay tuned I guess.
loadstring([[
--!native
--!optimize 2
if game.GameId == 6035872082 then
	local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local Storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local Items = require(Storage.Modules.ItemLibrary).Items

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

	local ray = Ray.new
	local vec = Vector2.new
	local color = Color3.fromRGB
	local convert = camera.WorldToViewportPoint
	local byte = string.byte
	local caller = checkcaller
	local hookmetamethod = hookmetamethod

	local target = nil
	local distance = 1000
	local visibility = false

	local parent = Instance.new("ScreenGui", (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui"))
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)
	label.Size, label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 25), UDim2.new(1, -260, 0, 10)
	label.BackgroundTransparency, label.TextColor3 = 1, color(255, 255, 255)
	label.Font, label.TextSize = Enum.Font.Code, 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	label.Text = "READY"

	local exceptions = {
		["Sniper"] = true,
		["Crossbow"] = true,
		["Bow"] = true,
		["RPG"] = true,
	}

	for name, data in pairs(Items) do
		if typeof(data) == "table" and not exceptions[name] then
			if data.ShootSpread then data.ShootSpread = 0 end
			if data.ShootAccuracy then data.ShootAccuracy = 0 end
			if data.ShootRecoil then data.ShootRecoil = 0 end
			if data.ShootCooldown then data.ShootCooldown = 0.05 end
			if data.ShootBurstCooldown then data.ShootBurstCooldown = 0.05 end
		end
	end

	local function bite(attr)
		return byte(attr or "\0")
	end

	local function visible(targetPart, cam)
		if not visibility then return true end
		
		local dir = (targetPart.Position - cam)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, targetPart.Parent, Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris") }
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(cam, dir.Unit * distance, params)

		return result == nil or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
	end

	local function valid(plr, cam)
		local char = plr.Character
		if not char then return false end

		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not (hum and head and hum.Health > 0) then return false end

		local mag = (head.Position - cam).Magnitude
		if mag > distance then return false end

		local ours, theirs = player:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID"), plr:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
		if ours and theirs and bite(ours) ~= bite(theirs) then return false end

		local ours, theirs = player:GetAttribute("TeamID"), plr:GetAttribute("TeamID")
		if ours and theirs and bite(ours) == bite(theirs) then return false end

		return visible(head, cam)
	end

	Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cam = camera.CFrame.Position
		local best, distance = nil, math.huge
		local center = camera.ViewportSize / 2

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if plr ~= player and valid(plr, cam) then
				local pos, on = convert(camera, plr.Character.Head.Position)
				if on then
					local d = (vec(pos.X, pos.Y) - center).Magnitude
					if d < distance then
						distance, best = d, plr
					end
				end
			end
		end

		target = best and best.Character.Head.Position or nil
		label.Text = best and "LOCKED: " .. best.Name:upper() or "SCANNING..."
		label.TextColor3 = best and color(0, 255, 150) or color(255, 80, 80)
	end)

	local _idx
	_idx = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, idx, ...)
		if target and not caller() and idx == "ViewportSize" and self == camera then
			local pos, on = convert(self, target)
			if on then
				return vec(pos.X * 2, pos.Y * 2)
			end
		end
		return _idx(self, idx, ...)
	end))
end
]])()

It separates the targeting logic from the hooks so the impact on your frame rate won't be that big, at least when compared to other such scripts. It is a 30 fps improvement from the best I could find so I thought other people might find it useful.

scripts.features:
Here's a full breakdown of every feature in CHAINIX Universal:

⚔️ Combat

Rage Mode — Teleports to enemies and kills them one by one, auto-respawns if you die
Auto Loadout — Automatically picks your weapons when a round starts; customizable primary, secondary, melee, and utility slots with arrow selectors
Aimbot — Hold RMB to lock onto enemies; includes FOV circle, wall check, and mouse movement alignment
FOV Circle — Toggle the aimbot FOV visualizer
FOV Radius slider — Adjust aimbot FOV size (50–500)
Smoothness slider — Control how snappy the aimbot locks on
Triggerbot — Auto-fires when your crosshair is over an enemy; configurable delay
Trigger Delay slider — Set delay in milliseconds (0–200ms)
Aim Assist — Subtle camera nudge toward nearby enemies (least detectable)
Assist Strength slider — Control how strong the nudge is
Instant Reload — Patches reload timers to near-zero


👁️ ESP

Enable ESP — Master toggle for all ESP features
Show Names — Display player usernames above their character
Show Health — Show HP bar and numbers
Show Distance — Show how far away each player is in meters
Highlight / Wallhack — Highlights players through walls; color-coded by team


🏃 Movement

Speed Boost — Increases walk speed with a slider (16–100)
Infinite Jump — Allows jumping mid-air repeatedly (keybind: J)
Jump Power slider — Adjust jump height (50–200)
Flight System — Full fly mode with WASD + Space/Shift controls (keybind: C)
Flight Speed slider — Adjust flight speed (20–200)
Noclip — Walk through walls (keybind: N)


👥 Players

Player list — Shows all players with live distance and health
Teleport to Player — One-click teleport to any player
Refresh button — Manually refresh the player list
Auto-refresh — Updates when players join or leave


🌐 Server

Rejoin Server — Reconnects to the same server
Server Hop — Finds and joins a different server
Join Low Player Server — Finds the server with fewest players
Live Ping display — Shows your current ping with color-coded indicator
Hop for Better Ping — Auto-hops if your ping is above 80ms


🎛️ Misc

Performance Mode — Disables shadows and lowers quality for FPS boost
Remove Textures — Strips all part textures for extra FPS
No Fog — Removes world fog
FPS Unlocker — Sets FPS cap to 240
Fullbright — Maximizes lighting brightness
Zoom Extender — Extends camera zoom distance to 1000 studs
No Camera Shake — Locks camera to prevent shake effects
FOV Changer — Custom FOV with slider (70–120), continuously enforced
Show FPS — On-screen FPS counter with color coding
Show Ping — On-screen ping counter with color coding
Auto Respawn — Auto-respawns your character on death
8 Themes — White (Default), Dark Mode, Ocean Blue, Neon Pink, Matrix Green, Blood Red, Purple, Gold


⚙️ Settings

Enable/Disable Notifications
Enable/Disable Sounds
Auto Save Config — Saves settings to a file between sessions
Save Config Now / Reload Config / Reset to Defaults
Custom Crosshair — Minimal crosshair overlay
Toggle UI keybind — Rebindable (default: Insert)
Unload Script keybind — Rebindable (default: Delete)
Hide UI button
Feature keybinds — Rebind Flight, Infinite Jump, ESP, and Noclip individually
Unload CHAINIX — Full cleanup with character respawn


ℹ️ Info

Version info and credits
Discord invite link (copies to clipboard)
Changelog summary

scripts.script:
local function if_player_is_on_round_or_another(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID") ~= nil
end

local function chid_to_id(chid)
	return string.byte(chid or string.char(0))
end

local function id_to_chid(id)
	return string.char(id or 0)
end

local function get_every_player_in_Environment(id)
	local output = {}
	for k, v in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Player") and if_player_is_on_round_or_another(v) and chid_to_id(v:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")) == id then
			table.insert(output, {["chidteam"] = v:GetAttribute("TeamID"),["player"] = v})
		end
	end
	return output
end

local function get_every_player_in_Environment_but_without_thisteam(id,id2)
	local output = get_every_player_in_Environment(id)
	for k = #output, 1, -1 do
    	local v = output[k]
    	if chid_to_id(v["chidteam"]) == id2 then
    	    table.remove(output, k)
    	end
	end
	return output
end

local function get_every_player_in_Environment_but_only_enemy(id,id2)
	local output = get_every_player_in_Environment(id)
	for k = #output, 1, -1 do
    	local v = output[k]
    	if chid_to_id(v["chidteam"]) ~= id2 then
    	    table.remove(output, k)
    	end
	end
	return output
end
